P(F|G) = P(G|F) * P(F) / P(G)

P(G) = P(G|F) * P(F) + P(G|C) * P(C)
= 0.68 * 0.29 + 0.41 * 0.71
= 0.1972 + 0.2911
= 0.4883

Now, we can calculate P(F|G):
P(F|G) = 0.68 * 0.29 / 0.4883
= 0.1972 / 0.4883
≈ 0.403

So, given the grey weather icon, the chance of getting a foggy map is approximately 40.3%.
